blocks.text: MANILA – A Filipino woman believed to be a potential human trafficking victim in a suspected surrogacy scheme was intercepted at Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 1, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said Monday. According to a report received by BI Commissioner Joel Anthony Viado, the passenger initially declared that she was traveling to Thailand for a seven-day vacation on Sept. 15. Due to inconsistencies in her statements, the primary immigration officer referred her to the Immigration Protection and Border Enforcement Section (I-PROBES) for further verification.
